title: BalancerWinddownPlan Stage 2 steps 7/10 (register/unregister with Pauser; 'dispatch works while pooler paused') conflict with story-048 (no pauser(), pause() is onlyMinter and blocks dispatch); the pool-only kill switch incrementAuthVersion() is named by neither
description: The code follows the story, and the story is authoritative: UniPoolerV2 has no pauser() and cannot be registered with the Pauser. pause() is onlyMinter (base), and pausing blocks dispatch, which means index-4 mints, as well as pool(). Read literally, plan steps 7 and 10 are unexecutable: register would revert and BalancerPoolerV2 was never registered. The plan's safety intent of stopping pooling without stopping mints is still achievable, through owner incrementAuthVersion(), which mass-revokes pool() and leaves _dispatch untouched. Neither document names that lever.
impact: None in code (code follows story-048). Operational: an operator following BalancerWinddownPlan Stage 2 steps 7/10 (Pauser registration; 'dispatch works while pooler paused') would find no pauser() and that pause() blocks dispatch - index-4 mints would revert (fail-loud, no loss). The pool-only kill switch incrementAuthVersion() is named by neither doc.
attackPath: Not an attack: plan/story conflict that misleads the cutover script author
likelihood: medium that the plan is followed as written
assumptions: Cutover script (phStaging2:100/103) is written from the plan
severityJustification: Law-2 spec conflict between a supporting plan and the authoritative story; code is faithful. Informational in spec-conformance; route to script-auditor (unipooler-cutover) where the downstream risk lives.
recommendation: Amend the plan: delete Stage 2 step 7's Pauser registration and step 10's unregister, rewrite the Stage 1a test as 'dispatch works while pool() is unavailable', and record incrementAuthVersion() as the pool-only kill switch. Check this when script-auditor runs on unipooler-cutover.
knownIssueCheck: No KI match. KI#5 (pauser trust) is about who may pause, not about a plan step that contradicts the story's pause semantics.
specText: Plan Stage 2 step 7: "Register with the Pauser." Step 10: "Retire the old pooler: pause it and unregister it from the Pauser." Plan Stage 1a test: "Dispatch still works while the pooler is paused."
